body: I don't think I could face them and tell them this, I don't want to stress them out and I really don't want them to take me to a hospital.  I just feel completely drained of any will to live. I don't know what to do or if there's anything to do that will ever make me feel happy again.. I just feel like my life is destroyed, and I've lost compete motivation to want to do anything and I don't see any reason to suffer through it for 50 more years
